rejected.file: Chicago Collections / Chicago History Museum, DN-0050207, "[Church of the Providence of God]" (1906 Chicago Daily News glass negative)
reasons: Building mismatch: the photographed structure is a modest three-story brick combined church-and-school with a small cross-topped gable front -- not the current standing 1927 Romanesque Revival twin-steeple church at 717 W. 18th St. (designed by Leo Strelka). Research shows the parish's building was erected in 1901 (combined church/school), rebuilt/expanded in 1914, and rebuilt again as the present church in 1927 -- so this 1906 photo predates and does not depict the standing structure the site documents.

Address discrepancy, unresolved: the Chicago Collections catalog record gives this building's address as '668 West 18th Street (formerly 166 West 18th Street)', not the parish's documented current address of 717 W. 18th Street (confirmed independently via Flickr, Yelp, ChicagoAncestors.org, and our own case record). Given finding #1 above, this is most plausibly a genuinely different (since-replaced) building rather than a renumbering artifact, but it could not be resolved with confidence either way.

No public-domain/reuse rights statement exists on the source page itself -- only a physical-handling note ('Original negatives are fragile and not available to researchers. Please consult the on-line image instead'), which is not a copyright disposition.

Copyright basis genuinely unresolved as of the verification date (2026-07-27): publication status of this specific negative is unknown. If unpublished, the 120-year corporate-work term under 17 U.S.C. Sec. 302(c) for an item created in 1906 runs through December 31, 2026 and would not enter the public domain until January 1, 2027 -- i.e., not yet, even on the most favorable unpublished-work theory. If it was published (printed in the Chicago Daily News) before 1930 it would already be public domain, but no evidence of publication was found. No Commons or DPLA mirror of this specific negative exists to supply a clearer rights determination.

Net: reject pending either (a) confirmation that 668 W. 18th St. and 717 W. 18th St. are the same lot under some renumbering this research did not surface, and (b) a firmer copyright basis (evidence of pre-1930 publication, or simply waiting until Jan 1, 2027 for the unpublished-work term to lapse).
